wikimediaantiabuse-api-review-permission: You do not have permission to change the review status of this revision.
wikimediaantiabuse-api-review-not-flagge: This revision is not marked with an abuse review tag.
wikimediaantiabuse-api-falsepositive-not: This revision is not marked as a false positive.
wikimediaantiabuse-api-review-disabled: This REST API is not enabled on this wiki.
wikimediaantiabuse-api-review-unknown-ta: The tag "$1" is not a reviewable tag.
wikimediaantiabuse-api-review-blocked: You cannot use this API while you are blocked from editing.
wikimediaantiabuse-api-review-mark-descr: Records a review verdict on a revision. The only verdict is `false-positive`, which removes the reviewable tag and adds its false positive version. For example, the `mw-private-personal-info` tag becomes the `mw-private-personal-info-false-positive` tag. Requires the ability to see the tag you are changing.
wikimediaantiabuse-api-review-unmark-des: Removes a review verdict from a revision. The only verdict is `false-positive`, which removes the false positive version of the tag and restores the reviewable tag. For example, the `mw-private-personal-info-false-positive` tag becomes the `mw-private-personal-info` tag. Requires the ability to see the tag you are changing.
